notes.range_nmi: The cited search detection range. Published APG-68 ranges disagree and none states its target: 35 nm look-up (Radartutorial), ~43 nmi ('50 mi', Wikipedia citing Deagel), ~57 nmi against 5 m2 (a wiki mirror). 50 nmi sits at the top of that spread. See docs/VALIDATION.md (Sources > Radar).
notes.rcs_m2: The reference target the citation is read against: a 5 m2 fighter-sized target, no aspect factor: one reference size for fitting and testing, radar and seeker alike. Not the F-16 type's own RCS, which is the shape estimate in aircraft.json signature.rcs_shape: nose-on (3.78 m2) the same radar's coin flip is at 46.6 nmi, beam-on (25.4 m2) 75.1 nmi.
notes.reference_fluctuation: The reference target fluctuates as Swerling 1, like the F-16 type: the cited range is read as the range at which ONE look detects it with probability 0.5.
